label: Friday's chances, in goals
note: Final: Sabres 5, Blue Jackets 2. 10 Buffalo rebound shots, their most this season.

explainer.title: Rebounds are gold.
explainer.text: A shot right after another one catches the goalie out of position. Over the last three NHL seasons, rebounds went in 11.5% of the time, nearly double the 6.3% for other shots. Buffalo had 10 of them Friday.
